resolution: Tested the user's baseline cells EI10 EI11 EI12 EJ12 EK12 through the real-GPU /mesh path. These were given as a known-good baseline (they render correctly on screen) so the test must report PASS there. Initial run false-flagged EI11/EI12 as concrete; root cause was the harness locating each fiducial by its single brightest pixel, skewing the homography by ~a cell into the adjacent concrete sidewalk. Fixed by using the colour-blob CENTROID. After the fix all five read ROAD on /mesh, matching the user's eyes — proving the test discriminates correctly (passes where rendering is right, fails where it's wrong) rather than always crying concrete. Committed in the test-evolution SHAs.
